# Status

The status summary of a node.

## Where it is served

| Surface | Where |
| ------- | ----- |
| API | `/api/node/{hostname}/status`, in [API](/category/api) |
| CLI | `osapi client node status` |
| Jobs | `behavior.status.<method>`, run by the agent |

## Built on

| Uses | Used by |
| ---- | ------- |
| [hostname](../hostname/hostname.md), [uptime](../uptime/uptime.md), [os](../os/os.md), [load](../load/load.md), [memory](../memory/memory.md), [disk](../disk/disk.md) | Nothing |

## Where it runs

On `linux`, `darwin`. On any other platform its methods report `skipped`.

In a trace, a call is the span `behavior.status.<method>`, with `behavior.hostname.<method>`, `behavior.uptime.<method>`, `behavior.os.<method>`, `behavior.load.<method>`, `behavior.memory.<method>`, `behavior.disk.<method>`, `exec hostnamectl`, `exec hostname`, `exec sysctl`, `exec sw_vers`, `exec vm_stat`, `exec df`, `exec lsblk`, `exec mount`, `exec zfs` under it.
